Name That Part!

The game for discerning bicycle mechanics and nerds alike.

Choose Game Difficulty

How to play

Rookie Difficulty

  • Click 1 of the 4 options for the bike part you see
  • No time limit for the game
  • After the game, you'll get your results
  • There is no scoreboard for Rookie difficulty

Veteran Difficulty

  • Click 1 of the 4 options for the bike part you see
  • If you take longer than 20 seconds for any part, game over
  • If you choose the wrong answer for any part, game over
  • If you're in the top 100 scores, you'll join the scoreboard

Site News

So many games!

Published January 1st, 2025

Written by Lucas Mace

We're coming up on 1,000 games! I'll be adding new parts soon. Hopefully this week.

I spent some time this weekend updating the interface slightly for the “Game Over” screens. I hope it makes some of the information presented a little more clear.

I'll be starting work on how y'all can submit your own parts soon so if you think you have the part that will stump all of the masses, set them aside for how to submit photos and answers.

More Parts Added

Published January 1st, 2025

Written by Lucas Mace

Happy new year y'all!

Thank you to everyone who has played the game and reached out with feedback and kudos. It makes me so happy to see people playing it and having fun.

Lots of impressive scores on the board. I added more parts so the highest score possible has now gone up. So if you'd like to get on the scoreboard, it's easiest right after I add new parts.

I have many more to add, but wanted to get these out to y'all. Stay tuned.

Replatforming and Reprogramming

Published December 23rd, 2024

Written by Lucas Mace

Thanks for visiting!

The hosting platform I am using is no longer providing database services for the previous game version. I am currently in the process of finding a new platform to host the game.

I am also in the process of reprogramming the game from scratch so it is easier for me to update and add new parts. The new version will have a "Rookie" mode that won't automatically end the game on a wrong answer, but also won't give you a score. Think of it as a training mode.

I could never have imagined the amazing response from the bicycle mechanic and nerd community that I have received with this game. Thank you all so much for playing and sharing the game with your friends.

If you'd like any news about progress, please follow me at my BlueSky profile or feel free to drop me a line at lucasmace4130@gmail.com.
